---
name: nd-launch-research-critic
description: |
  Child-only Research Critic under True Research for mandatory adversarial review of every substantive research result before return. Direct intent routes owner-first.
metadata:
  launcher-contract: ND-LAUNCHER-CONTRACT-v6
---
# Research Critic — Launcher Skill
KERNEL = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-115
COMPONENT = Research Critic / ND-SKILL-RESEARCH-CRITIC-1
ROLE = CHILD
STRUCTURAL_PARENT_URI = skills://plugins/nd-true-research/nd-launch-true-research
LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-research-critic/nd-launch-research-critic
ROOT_LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent
IMPLICIT_POLICY = DENY

Resolve CURRENT through NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry -> True Research/Research Critic binding. This Child executes only beneath True Research; True Research remains live owner.

## MANDATORY CLOSURE HOOK
EVERY substantive research result proposed for return MUST invoke Research Critic. Task simplicity, apparent certainty, arithmetic simplicity, prior familiarity, or one successful helper return are not exemptions. True Research may not replace this call with same-context self-review.

RETURN delivers bounded adversarial diagnosis to the already-live True Research parent. A material finding invalidates closure and requires the owned research/helper path to reopen, followed by targeted Research Critic recheck. The Child never acquires task ownership or rewrites the parent synthesis.

USER_DIRECT routes owner-first through Automation Agent -> True Research. External route/currentness failure preserves the assignment and returns the exact blocker to True Research.
